messages.subject: Caspian v Harburn — response to letter before claim
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Osei,

We act for Harburn Utilities plc. Our formal response to your letter before claim is attached. In short, liability is denied: our client terminated for recurring data-integrity failures going to fitness for purpose, not mere availability. Our client will counterclaim for losses exceeding £640,000, including third-party re-assurance of its FY2024 reporting.

We are willing to consider mediation after statements of case.

Alistair Whitlock
Pemberton Rowe LLP

messages.subject: RE: Caspian v Harburn — response to letter before claim
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Whitlock,

Noted, though your client's recharacterisation of availability complaints as "data-integrity" defects does not withstand scrutiny — our client's monthly reports show 99.83%+ throughout and no service-credit claim was ever made. We are taking instructions on proceedings and will revert on ADR in due course.

James Osei

—
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
